# CLI

`sluice serve` and `sluice mcp` start a server. The other commands run once and exit.

Every command accepts `--help`. A `bool` flag takes no value. The binary also has the standard `help` and `completion` commands.

`--config` reads only the file you name. A missing file is not an error: the defaults apply.

## Exit codes

| Code | Command | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | all | Success. |
| 1 | all | Wrong flags, a file that cannot be read, or a failed start. |
| 1 | `policy test` | A policy does not compile. |
| 1 | `datasource check` | A policy file is not valid, or the name is unknown. |
| 2 | `serve` | A listener failed, for example the port is in use. |
| 2 | `datasource check` | The directory holds no `DataSource` object. |
| 3 | `config validate`, `policy validate`, `policy explain` | A policy or the server config is not valid. |
| 3 | `policy test` | A policy file is not valid, a case failed, or no case ran. |
| 4 | `audit verify` | The hash chain is broken, a line is not JSON, or the anchor differs. |

## apikey hash

Compute the hex HMAC for an API key.

`sluice apikey hash [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--id` | string |  | public key identifier |
| `--material` | string |  | key material presented by the client |
| `--pepper` | string |  | server pepper, raw value or secret:// URI |

All three flags are required. See [API keys](../policies/subjects.md).

## audit verify

Validate the audit-log hash chain under `<audit-dir>`.

`sluice audit verify <audit-dir> [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--anchor` | string |  | expected prior_hash of the first record: the hex SHA-256 of the genesis |
| `--json` | bool |  | emit the report as JSON |

See [Audit log](../security/audit.md).

## budget show

Show a subject's budget usage for a day (default today, UTC).

`sluice budget show <subject> [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--day` | string |  | UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD); default today |
| `--json` | bool |  | emit JSON |
| `--state-dir` | string | `./state` | budget state directory |

The state directory must exist. The command creates `budget.db` there if the file is missing.

## config validate

Validate the server config and the policy directory.

`sluice config validate <policy-dir> [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | string |  | path to the server config (optional) |
| `--strict` | bool |  | reject unknown YAML fields in policies |

The policy directory is optional. `sluice serve` runs the same checks at start.

## datasource check

Validate configured data sources.

`sluice datasource check [name] [flags]`

Short form: `sluice ds check`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | string | `./policies.d` | directory containing DataSource objects |
| `--json` | bool |  | emit the report as JSON |

The command does not connect to the data sources.

## mcp

Run the MCP server for AI agents (stdio by default).

`sluice mcp [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--allow-anonymous` | bool |  | run without a credential (queries default-denied unless a policy allows the anonymous subject) |
| `--api-key` | string |  | static API key to authenticate as (stdio) |
| `--config` | string |  | server config (SLUICE_* env also applies) |
| `--jwt` | string |  | static JWT bearer token to authenticate as (stdio) |
| `--policies-dir` | string |  | policy directory (overrides policies.directory) |
| `--transport` | string | `stdio` | transport: stdio or streamable_http (also http, streamable-http, streamablehttp) |

Without `--jwt`, the command reads the token from `SLUICE_MCP_TOKEN`. With `http`, `streamable-http` or `streamablehttp`, the command also needs `--api-key`, `--jwt` or `--allow-anonymous` at start. See [MCP tools](mcp.md).

## policy explain

Explain the effective policy for a subject and target.

`sluice policy explain [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--claims` | strings |  | extra claims as key=value (comma-separated) |
| `--email` | string |  | email of the subject |
| `--groups` | strings |  | subject groups (comma-separated) |
| `--issuer` | string |  | issuer (iss claim) |
| `--json` | bool |  | print the result as JSON |
| `--policies-dir` | string | `./policies.d` | directory containing policy files |
| `--sql` | string |  | SQL statement to explain. The command does not run it |
| `--table` | string |  | target table as catalog.schema.table |
| `--user` | string |  | subject id (required) |

You need `--user` and at least one of `--table` and `--sql`. This call asks which policies apply when `alice` reads one table:

```bash
--8<-- "examples/cli/steps/02-policy-explain.sh"
```

```text
--8<-- "examples/cli/expected/02-policy-explain.txt"
```

## policy test

Run declarative policy test suites against `<policy-dir>`.

`sluice policy test <policy-dir> [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | bool |  | emit the report as JSON |
| `--strict` | bool |  | reject unknown YAML fields in policies |
| `--tests` | string | `<policy-dir>/tests` | suite file or directory |

See [Testing policies](../policies/testing.md).

## policy validate

Validate every policy file under `<policy-dir>`.

`sluice policy validate <policy-dir> [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--strict` | bool |  | reject unknown YAML fields in policies |

A directory that does not exist counts as empty, and the command prints OK. A policy that does not compile gives exit status 3:

```bash
--8<-- "examples/cli/steps/03-validate-broken.sh"
```

```text
--8<-- "examples/cli/expected/03-validate-broken.txt"
```

## schema export

Export the JSON Schema of a policy kind.

`sluice schema export [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--kind` | string |  | policy kind to export, for example SqlAccessPolicy |

Without `--kind` the command ends with exit status 1. So does `--kind RowFilterPolicy`.

## serve

Start the Sluice server.

`sluice serve [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | string |  | path to the server config (defaults apply when omitted) |
| `--policies-dir` | string |  | override policies.directory from the server config |

Starts the REST API. The MCP server and the admin API start when the server config enables them. `SIGINT` and `SIGTERM` stop the server. `SIGHUP` reloads the policies. A binary built with `-tags=pure_parser` does not start.

## version

Print the build version.

`sluice version [flags]`

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | bool |  | emit version metadata as JSON |
